units: Loss/work/cost means and RMS in nats; covariance in nats squared
registration: Logit work contract fixed before this replay measurement, following recorded parameter-Taylor failures
scope: Actual-displacement response and curvature diagnostics; exact W+Q identity is a benchmark, not a predictive dynamics result
natural_population_scope: For natural data, population columns refer to the arbitrary official32000 teacher, not true natural risk
representation_remainder_scope: W−A includes nonlinear parameter-to-logit response plus numerical gradient/replay discrepancies; not a full Hessian identification

summary.scope: Exact logit finite work/cost, parameter-gradient prediction and representation remainder; initial128 updates replay verified against stored CE.
